qc.label_under_test: On the word right after me or us that opens a description of me or us (often 'as', 'a', 'for', 'my' or 'our') when a characterisation bounces back: an earlier clause has me or us characterising another person or group (seeing, regarding, calling or thinking them something, or praising, admiring, criticising, thanking, rewarding or punishing them for something), and the next clause has that person or group characterise me or us in the same way. Weaker: the same two-way swap between third-person pronouns. Silent: a returned attitude with no description of me or us after the pronoun (they trusted us, he feared me); a one-way characterisation of me or us with no earlier clause; me or us characterised first and then answering back; an ordinary returned action (visiting, lending, paying, hugging back); a characterisation aimed at a thing rather than a person.

fire: I always saw her as a mentor, and she in turn saw me as a friend.
We regarded the visiting team as worthy rivals, and they regarded us as equals.
I thanked him for his patience, and he thanked me for my honesty.
We admired our neighbors for their generosity, and they admired us for our kindness.
I called him a genius, and he called me a fool for believing it.
The coach praised us for our effort after we had praised her for her planning.
I thought of them as family, and they thought of me as one of their own.
We criticised the council for its delays, and the council criticised us for our impatience.
quiet: I always saw her as a mentor, and she trusted me completely.
We regarded the visiting team highly, and they respected us.
I thanked him for his patience, and he lent me his umbrella.
Our neighbors admired us for our kindness when we first moved in.
He called me a fool, and I answered that he was a genius.
The coach praised us for our effort after the final match.
I thought of them as family, and they visited me every Sunday.
We criticised the council for its delays, and the council feared us.

predictions: Blind test written from the label alone. Expect 6/8 fire (the reversed-order coach item may be weak), 0-1 near misses at 0.30.
